Meta.Purpose: Generate deep, practical content for a single C++ learning section
Meta.ContentStyle: Clear explanations + syntax rules + compilable code examples + common pitfalls + best practices
Meta.OutputFormat: React JSX component using the LearnCpp content block components

LanguageEvolution.Instruction: Which C++ standard introduced this feature, why it was needed, what problem it solved, and what came before it

Motivation.Instruction: Real-world problem this concept solves. Show the problem BEFORE the solution. Use a relatable scenario (game dev, systems programming, embedded, etc.)

InformalIntuition.Instruction: Plain-English explanation with analogies. No code yet. Build mental model first.

Syntax.Instruction: Exact C++ syntax with grammar rules. Use SyntaxBlock and DefinitionBlock components.

Rules.Instruction: Language rules, guarantees, and behavior specifications from the C++ standard
Rules.Include: what the standard guarantees, implementation-defined behavior, order of evaluation

MemoryVisualization.Instruction: Specify interactive visualization showing memory layout, object lifetime, or data flow
MemoryVisualization.WhatToShow: Describe exactly what the visualization should demonstrate

RealWorldApplication.WhereUsedInPractice: List specific domains: game engines, OS kernels, embedded systems, HPC, databases

CompilerNotes.Instruction: GCC vs Clang vs MSVC differences, useful compiler flags, diagnostics

UndefinedBehavior.Instruction: Any undefined behavior related to this topic. Use WarningBlock component.
UndefinedBehavior.Include: what causes UB, how to detect it (sanitizers), how to avoid it

CommonMistakes.Instruction: List 3-5 common errors, misconceptions, or pitfalls beginners make

BestPractices.Instruction: Modern C++ best practices for this topic. Use BestPracticeBlock component.
BestPractices.Sources: C++ Core Guidelines, Effective Modern C++, CppCon talks

ComponentLibrary.AvailableComponents: CppCode — Syntax-highlighted C++ code with copy button (props: code, title, language) OutputBlock — Terminal-style program output (props: output) DefinitionBlock — Concept definition (props: term, children) SyntaxBlock — Syntax pattern/rule (props: title, children) BestPracticeBlock — Best practice recommendation (props: title, children) ExampleBlock — Worked example with collapsible steps (props: title, steps[]) ExerciseBlock — Practice exercise (props: title, difficulty, children) NoteBlock — Important note (props: title, children) WarningBlock — Warning/UB alert (props: title, children) CompilerNoteBlock — Compiler-specific note (props: compiler, children) ReferenceList — Reference links (props: references[])
